text: Teaching Objective After the course you will be equipped the knowledge of software engineering and the development of advanced technology, with software development and management ability. Main Courses Fundamental of Program Design, Object-Oriented Programming, Higher Mathematics, Discrete Mathematics, Operating System, Computer Network, Principle of Computer systems, Database Principle and Application, Introduction to Software Engineering, Software Test Technology Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering in Liaocheng University. School of Computing, Liaocheng University
